title: Using SQL in a 4D Database Application
author: Timothy Tse, Technical Services Team Member, 4D Inc.
featured_technology: 4D native commands (CREATE TABLE/ALTER TABLE equivalents, QUERY, CREATE RECORD, relations)

historical_commentary.text: 4D's embedded SQL engine and side-by-side 4D-command equivalence described here are still present and functional in current 4D, so this note remains directly usable reference material, though modern applications increasingly favor ORDA's object/entity-based querying over either raw 4D commands or embedded SQL for new development.
related_updates: ORDA (entity selections, `.query()`, class-based data access) introduced from v16 R5/17+ as a newer alternative to both classic 4D commands and SQL for data access
4D's SQL engine itself has continued to receive updates since this 2014 note
